## Specific task description

Task instruction: Transfer the oval bread and the bread loaf medium-sized from the table to the medium light brown breadbasket.

Task description: Move the oval bread at the lower left of the image and the nearly square medium bread higher on the left from the table into the light-brown medium woven bread basket at the lower right of the image.

Success criteria: Both pieces of bread have been placed in the basket, close to it in both front-back and left-right directions and above the tabletop. Both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping the thicker middle of the oval bread on both sides with the gripper closing across its short axis. Avoid the rounded ends and top groove, where it may slip more easily.
- For nearly square bread, grip the middle of opposite sides and avoid all four corners. Open slightly wider than the grasp section and confirm both pads surround it before closing rather than merely overlapping its top in the image.
- When crossing the basket rim, leave height clearance for both the bottom of the bread and the fingertips. If its pose needs adjustment, do so where there is ample space above the basket opening to avoid brushing the wall with the bread or fingers.
- If one piece of bread is already in the basket, adjust the other piece's landing point to fit the remaining space and leave room to withdraw the fingers, avoiding moving the placed bread or hitting the basket wall.
- During release, let the bread rest securely on the basket bottom or on bread already inside before opening the gripper and withdrawing upward, reducing the risk of bouncing out or being pulled out by the fingertips.
